name: retrieve_story
description: retrives inspiring story based on the user's current situation and feelings (user prompt). The output will be a coherent text in the chosen theme, type, and style, reflecting the user's emotional context.

user_prompt.description: A required description of the user's current situation, struggles, or feelings.

theme.description: Optional. The theme under which the story should be developed.

type.description: Optional. The narrative form or genre for the story.

style.description: Optional. The style in which the story should be written.
